description: This tool is for analyzing Stripe Sigma and Metrics data (e.g. about revenue, charges, products, invoices, subscriptions, disputes, transactions, tax tables, payments etc) and run…

intent.description: The intent of the tool call.

params.description: The parameters for the tool call. Required parameters depend on the intent.

currency.description: Used with execute_metric. Optional currency code for monetary results.

ends_at.description: Used with execute_metric. ISO 8601 datetime for the end of the time range. Must not be in the future: for "today", "this month", or "through today", use the current time, not the end of the day or period. A future value is capped to the time the query executes, and the current period's bucket may be incomplete.

filters.description: Used with execute_metric. Optional map of dimension key to an array of string values, e.g. {"country": ["US", "CA"]}. At most 10 values per key. Without group_by, at most 2 keys; with group_by, at most 1 key besides the group_by dimension.

granularity.description: Used with execute_metric. Aggregation granularity: day, week, month, or year.

group_by.description: Used with execute_metric. Optional dimension key to group by. Only one supported.

id.description: Used with execute_metric. Metric ID. Mutually exclusive with name.

include.description: Used with retrieve_query_run or retrieve_report_run. Results are inline under result.inline by default; pass ["result.file"] to get a downloadable file link instead.

limit.description: Used with retrieve_query_run or retrieve_report_run. Maximum number of inline result rows to return. Defaults to 100, maximum 1000.

name.description: Used with execute_metric. The metric name (from a `metric` search result).

page.description: With retrieve_query_run or retrieve_report_run, pass the result.inline.next_page_url value from a previous response to fetch the next page of inline result rows.

query_run_id.description: Used with retrieve_query_run. The QueryRun ID to retrieve.

report_id.description: Used with retrieve_report_type and create_report_run. The unique identifier of the `Report` object (format report_*).

report_parameters.description: Used with create_report_run. A map of parameter names to values for `Report Run` customization.

report_run_id.description: Used with retrieve_report_run. The unique identifier of the `Report Run` object (format reprun_* or rrun_*, depending on which API created it).

result_options.description: Used with execute_query_run or create_report_run. Optional settings for the generated results.

compression.description: Compression applied to the generated results file. Defaults to none.

search_string.description: Used with stripe_data_search. Keywords to match against the names and descriptions of the available metrics, tables, and reports.

sql.description: Used with execute_query_run. The SQL query to execute (Trino 414).

starts_at.description: Used with execute_metric. ISO 8601 datetime for the start of the time range.

table_name.description: Used with retrieve_query_table. The table name.

timezone.description: Used with execute_metric. Optional timezone for the result set.

name: stripe.stripe_analytics
